tips.text: Hold back 16 Shrill, 12 Bellow and 1 Echo Voca for the rank-ups before handing the rest to Loid.
Hand in a full pack of Voca in one sitting; Voca are medallions and skip the daily standing cap.
Take the free quest copy and skip Munio at first; the Tome Mods are a separate grind most players call the worst in the game.
Expect Whispers in the Walls to take one evening once The New War is done.
